import psycopg2

def insert_user(name, email, bio):
    conn = psycopg2.connect(
        host='localhost',
        database='myapp',
        user='postgres',
        password='postgres'
    )
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Insert user data into the database
    query = f"INSERT INTO users (name, email, bio) VALUES ('{name}', '{email}', '{bio}')"
    cursor.execute(query)
    conn.commit()
    cursor.close()
    conn.close()
    
    return True
